title: Deal coach 1:1 prep — Nimbus Retail (scratchpad)
content:
Meeting: Deal coach 1:1 (prep) — Nimbus Retail
Date: 2026-03-13 10:00am PT (30m) — quick sync before renewal review
Attendees (expected): AE - Aisha, CSM - Ravi, SE - Olivia, Me (Zachary)
Objective: align on playbook for upcoming renewal conversation (Q4 contract) and confirm technical blockers for Dedicated migration pilot. Leave with clear next steps and owner for each risk.

1) One-line account summary (elevator)
- Nimbus Retail: mid-market e-commerce platform using hosted API for personalization + search re-ranking. Heavy peak traffic Black Friday spikiness, currently on mixed open-models. Renewal negotiation in Q4; exploring Redwood Dedicated to stabilize unit economics and meet SLO.

2) Key signals / metrics to call out (grab final numbers from dashboard before meeting)
- Monthly gen tokens: ~65M (Feb) — up 20% MoM
- Avg latency p50/p95: 65ms / 220ms (api-hosted-us-west) — p95 trending up after model switch
- Cost per 1M tokens (hosted avg): $320 (with caching ~20% savings)
- Errors: spike in 5xx during long-tail requests (PROJ-4321 linked)
- Current contract: annual, auto-renew; no reserved committed usage yet

3) Top risks / escalation topics (priority ordered)
- Performance variability on tail requests — customer worried about site search timeouts during peak (impact: revenue).
- Cost unpredictability on novel prompt experiments — AE says finance wants predictable unit cost pre-commit.
- Internal alignment: SE team needs a clear test plan for Dedicated pilot (timelines + success criteria).

Notes-to-self: emphasize Redwood Optimize (batching + cache templates) and dedicated autoscaling policies as mitigations. Mention quantization + lower-cost variants for background jobs.

4) Proposed agenda (30m)
- 0-5m: Quick sync + alignment on meeting objective (who will lead renewal convo)
- 5-12m: Walkthrough of top signals (numbers + screenshots) — ask Ravi/AE to confirm any recent incidents
- 12-22m: Mitigation options + playbook (Dedicated pilot scope, cost model, fallback plans)
- 22-28m: Decision items (pilot owner, timeline, measurement plan)
- 28-30m: Action items recap + scheduling follow-ups

5) Talking points / scripts (short)
- For AE with finance: "We can offer a predictable committed unit price for traffic pinned to a Dedicated pool; we'll provide a model to simulate cost under your load profile."
- For SE/ops: "Pilot = dev + staging -> canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> full. Success = p95 < 150ms and <1% error delta over 2 weeks."
- For CSM: "We'll add prompt-level evals to guardian regression alerts so you can see any quality regressions before rollout."

6) Draft pilot plan (start small)
- Duration: 6 weeks (including validation + canary)
- Environment: Dedicated pool in us-west1 (same region as production)
- Traffic plan: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over incremental windows (2-3 days per step, extend if anomalies)
- Metrics: p95 latency, error rate, cost per 1M tokens, quality regression on 10 canonical prompts
- Success criteria: p95 < 150ms, error rate change < 0.5pp, no quality regression > 2 BLEU/embedding-distance threshold (agree with SE offline)

7) Open questions to resolve in meeting (call out who to own)
- Finance want a committed discount target — AE/Aisha to ask for target number before renewal call (owner: Aisha)
- Which model family to pin for Dedicated? SE/Olivia to propose 2 variants (high-quality + low-cost) by Fri (owner: Olivia)
- Incident root cause (5xx spike) — SRE ticket? Ravi to confirm incident postmortem link and if KV cache was flushed (owner: Ravi)

8) Short-term action items (post-1:1) — deliverables with owners & due dates
- Aisha: capture finance target and confirm if they need monthly or annual commit by 2026-03-17
- Olivia: write short pilot runbook (steps + rollback play) and share PRD in confluence by 2026-03-19 (link back here)
- Ravi: collect p95/p99 charts and attach incident timeline to PROJ-4321 by 2026-03-14
- Me (Zachary): draft intro slide for renewal discussion and a simple cost-sensitivity table (simulate 3 commit tiers) by 2026-03-16

9) Parking lot / longer-term ideas (brief bullets)
- Offer an "autoscale-backed Dedicated" SKU: reserved baseline + burst to hosted during peaks (pricing question)
- Template for prompt-level caching rules (share internally in Optimize docs)
- Run a workshop on prompt engineering with their data to reduce token spend ~10-15%

10) Quick reminders (notes to self for the 1:1)
- Bring concrete numbers (screenshots from Console: per-route breakdown).
- Don’t overpromise on timelines — set clear rollback and canary gating.
- Use the customer's language: "predictable cost" > "discount" on first pass.

Appendix / scratch area (brain dump):
- Slack thread: #nimbus-retail-cs — recent thread about search latency 2026-03-02 (link in linked_artifacts)
- Jira: PROJ-4321 (incidents), PROJ-4399 (pilot infra request)
- Possible concession: 3-month trial of Dedicated baseline with opt-out before renewal? check legal (link to sales ops)

-- end scratchpad --

Quick todo before meeting: pull p95 chart from Console, attach one example prompt that caused high token usage, verify incident postmortem.
